description: The Interaction & Events block-heads `when`/`every`/`on_key`/`on_click` declared as procedures with Core Language alone: each raises `ol-reserved-word`. This is the byte-identical source its twin `block-heads-reserved-under-profile` runs with the profile ACTIVE, and both expect the same four diagnostics -- which is precisely what `spec/grammar.md:410` requires: "a program cannot declare which profiles it requires ... so a name that could be declared in one implementation but not in another would be invisible and unpredictable to a learner". It takes both fixtures to say so: either one alone is satisfied by an implementation that answers the same way for the wrong reason. `"check": true`: static legality only, nothing executes. `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: this fixture does not set `compareMessages`, so the harness compares its diagnostics on identity alone (issue #1025) -- and supplying a `message` without that flag is now a fixture ERROR rather than silently-ignored data, so nothing can sit here asserting nothing. Diagnostic identity is `code` plus `params` and "prose is presentation" (`spec/error-model.md:255-260`); the learner-facing wording is pinned by unit tests instead (`packages/parser/src/checker-reserved-word.test.mjs:236`).
